pros: Affordable and offers strong value for a small business.
Efficient item creation and organization for various data types.
Seamless browser integration and autofill for daily use.
cons: Occasional issues with browser extension performance or frequent re-login prompts.
Autofill suggestions may not always be perfectly accurate or can be intrusive.
Initial setup for team sharing and advanced features can be less intuitive.
